description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Authorize' responsible for handling authorization logic during the startup process of the OpenCart system. It manages access control based on user login status, two-factor authentication configuration, and authorization tokens, redirecting users appropriately.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class that manages authorization checks during system startup, including token validation, redirect logic based on user login and 2FA requirements.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that performs authorization logic by inspecting request route and cookies, validating tokens, and redirecting users accordingly.
